label: Cultured buttermilk
comment: Skimmed or low-fat milk soured with cultures, not what churning butter leaves (see buttermilk).
note: Despite the name, today's cultured buttermilk is not what is left from churning butter: it is skimmed or low-fat milk soured with lactic cultures. The US standard of identity allows the name "cultured buttermilk" for cultured milk.

about.text: Milk soured with lactic acid-producing cultures to a titratable acidity of at least 0.5 % as lactic acid. The US standard of identity for cultured milk lets it be sold as 'cultured buttermilk' when certain characterizing organisms are used. Not the sour liquid left from churning butter.
